note: guards 6fa67cb221 — zlrputs hardcoded `\e[` + cap + `m` instead of reading mcolors.files[COL_LC]/[COL_RC] (complist.c:569-571). The c:206 defaults are exactly those two strings, so the hardcoded form looked right until a config SET lc=/rc= — which zsh's own suite does (Test/comptest:44). That one gap accounted for 73 of the 88 failing Y-series assertions (53 of them alone). `zmodload zsh/complist` is load-bearing: without it both shells fall back to plain ilistmatches and emit no SGR at all, so the cell would pass without ever exercising the code.
